text: The word of the LORD came to me:
"Son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the city of blood? Then confront her with all her detestable deeds.

versions.text: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge the city of blood? Then confront her with all her detestable deeds.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew doubles the same verb for emphasis with a single object ('the city of blood'). Adding the pronoun 'her' in the first question introduces an antecedent that has not yet been mentioned, which is confusing when read aloud. Dropping 'her' preserves the emphatic repetition without the ambiguity.

text: Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: City that sheds blood in her midst, so bringing on her hour, city that has made idols for herself and so defiled herself—

versions.text: Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: City that sheds blood within herself, so that her hour has come, city that has made idols for herself and so defiled herself—
versions.explanation: The infinitive לָבוֹא עִתָּהּ expresses purpose/result ('so that her time may come'), not a completed event; 'her hour has come' states it as already accomplished. Also 'within herself' is better rendered 'in her midst' (בְּתוֹכָהּ), matching the phrase elsewhere in the chapter.

text: by the blood you have shed you have brought guilt upon yourself, and by the idols you have made you have defiled yourself. You have brought your days near and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you an object of scorn to the nations and a mockery to every land.
Those near and those far off will mock you, city of foul name, city full of turmoil.
See how the princes of Israel within you, each one relying on the strength of his arm, use their power to shed blood.

versions.text: See how the princes of Israel within you, each one by the strength of his arm, have shed blood.
versions.explanation: לְמַעַן שְׁפָךְ־דָּם is a purpose clause ('in order to shed blood'). The current rendering turns it into a simple past statement of fact and loses the sense that their power is wielded for the purpose of bloodshed.

text: Within you they have treated father and mother with contempt; they have oppressed the stranger in your midst; they have wronged the orphan and the widow.
You have despised what is holy to me and profaned my Sabbaths.
In you there are men who slander in order to shed blood; in you they eat at the mountain shrines and commit shameless acts in your midst.
In you a man uncovers his father's nakedness; in you they violate a woman during her time of impurity.
One man commits an abomination with his neighbor's wife, another defiles his daughter-in-law with lewdness, and another violates his sister, his own father's daughter—all this within you.
In you they take bribes to shed blood; you take interest and profit at another's expense, and you extort your neighbors by oppression. And me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
See, I strike my hands together over the dishonest gain you have made and over the blood you have shed in your midst.
Will your heart hold up? Will your hands be strong when the day comes that I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the lands, and I will purge your uncleanness from you.
You will be defiled in the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD."

versions.text: You will be defiled in the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.
versions.explanation: The quoted speech opened in verse 2 is never closed. The other two oracles in the chapter close their quotation marks (verses 22 and 31), so a closing quotation mark is needed here for consistency.

text: The word of the LORD came to me:
"Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead in the furnace; they are nothing but the dross of silver.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because all of you have become dross, I am going to gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

As silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin are gathered into a furnace to have the fire blown upon them to melt them, so I will gather you in my anger and my wrath, and I will put you in and melt you down.
I will collect you and blow upon you with the fire of my fury, and you will be melted within her.
As silver is melted in the furnace, so you will be melted within her. And you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath upon you."
The word of the LORD came to me:
"Son of man, say to her: You are a land that has not been cleansed, a land not rained upon in the day of wrath.
Her prophets conspire in her midst; like a roaring lion tearing its prey they devour lives, they seize treasure and precious things, they make many widows within her.

Her priests do violence to my law and profane what is holy to me. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they teach nothing about the difference between the unclean and the clean. They shut their eyes to my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and destroy lives to make unjust gain.
Her prophets whitewash it all for them with false visions and lying divinations, saying, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken.
The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery. They wrong the poor and the needy and oppress the stranger, denying him justice.
I searched among them for someone to repair the wall and stand before me in the breach on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it—but I found no one.
So I have poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my fury. I have brought their conduct down on their own heads, declares the Lord GOD."
